missions.name: Colonel Bairak
missions.description: "The Rise of Darkness" has roused many nameless heroes, still loyal to the true Hetman Verbenko, to stand united against the forces of chaos. Colonel Bairak is one of them. He is from Pereiaslav and is related to the holy emperor's family. We've been watching him carefully, and think he is destined for greatness. You are to help him rout Rotmistr Krzeminski, one of the Crown Army's top leaders. You will participate in a pincer movement. Colonel Bairak will attack from behind and you will attack from the front. The mission objective is to eliminate Rotmistr Krzeminski. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Chornohuz
missions.description: "The Rise of Darkness" has roused many nameless heroes, still loyal to the true Hetman Verbenko, to stand united against the forces of chaos. Colonel Chornohuz is one of them. He is from Myrhorod and is currently just an apprentice knight.. We've been watching him carefully, and think he is destined for greatness. You are to help him rout Rotmistr Zaleski, one of the Crown Army's top leaders. You will participate in a pincer movement. Colonel Chornohuz will attack from behind and you will attack from the front. The mission objective is to eliminate Rotmistr Zaleski. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Syvous
missions.description: "The Rise of Darkness" has roused many nameless heroes, still loyal to the true Hetman Verbenko, to stand united against the forces of chaos. Colonel Tykhyi is one of them. He is the lord of Uman and known as a fierce warrior.. We've been watching him carefully, and think he is destined for greatness. You are to help him rout Rotmistr Wolski, one of the Crown Army's top leaders. You will participate in a pincer movement. Colonel Tykhyi will attack from behind and you will attack from the front. The mission objective is to eliminate Rotmistr Wolski. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Vovkodav
missions.description: The Crown Army have dispatched their armies all over the continent. Osaul Zalizo, one of the three heads of the Crown Army and the younger brother of Kniaz Dominik, has entered the area and is vulnerable to attack. You will need to launch a full frontal assault on Osaul Zalizo. This is a tough mission, but if you are successful you will be richly rewarded. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Bairak
missions.description: Thanks in part to your brilliant assault, Rotmistr Krzeminski's brigade is now in tatters. Colonel Bairak has shifted his attention to engaging Kara-murza's army. The mission objective is to eliminate Kara-murza. What say you?

missions.name: Colonel Chornohuz
missions.description: Thanks in part to your brilliant assault, Rotmistr Zaleski's brigade is now in tatters. Colonel Chornohuz has shifted his attention to engaging Dzhanbek-bey's army. The mission objective is to eliminate Dzhanbek-bey. What say you?

missions.name: Colonel Syvous
missions.description: Thanks in part to your brilliant assault, Rotmistr Rudzki's brigade is now in tatters. Colonel Tykhyi has shifted his attention to engaging Kniaz Dominik's army. The mission objective is to eliminate Kniaz Dominik. What say you?

missions.name: Colonel Dovhan
missions.description: We are on the verge of a breakthrough! That evil dog, Kniaz Dominik, is in danger. His situation on the battlefield is desperate, and he has sent an urgent request for reinforcements. Your task is to engage Kniaz Dominik and vanquish the ferocious warriors that serve him before help arrives. Do you accept this critical mission?

missions.name: Colonel Shabliuk
missions.description: You've done well! Kniaz Dominik's armies have been annihilated, leading to a brief respite from this unending violence. However, the problem runs deeper than we thought: this time it is Colonel Kozub, Liege of Oleshky Sands, who is behind the chaos. After Kniaz Dominik went down in defeat, Colonel Kozub's stature within Chyhyryn grew, along with his armies and ambition.Colonel Kozub recently dethroned Hetman Verbenko the Grey, replacing him with his younger sister, the newly crowned Hetmanka Olena. Needless to say, Colonel Kozub is now the real power behind the throne. Heroes from around the kingdom have united to declare Colonel Kozub's actions unlawful and unsanctioned. Allied forces are marching to Chyhyryn as we speak! Colonel Bairak has set out with Colonel Kharko to support the Allies. Your job is to engage Colonel Kozub's new vassal, Oksana, the first female general in the Hetmanate's long history. Can you do it?

missions.name: Colonel Tuman
missions.description: You've done well! Kniaz Dominik's armies have been annihilated, leading to a brief respite from this unending violence. However, the problem runs deeper than we thought: this time it is Colonel Kozub, Liege of Oleshky Sands, who is behind the chaos. After Kniaz Dominik went down in defeat, Colonel Kozub's stature within Chyhyryn grew, along with his armies and ambition.Colonel Kozub recently dethroned Hetman Verbenko the Grey, replacing him with his younger sister, the newly crowned Hetmanka Olena. Needless to say, Colonel Kozub is now the real power behind the throne. Heroes from around the kingdom have united to declare Colonel Kozub's actions unlawful and unsanctioned. Allied forces are marching to Chyhyryn as we speak! Colonel Tuman of Black Sea is moving to support the Allies. Your job is to engage Colonel Kozub's new vassal, Oksana, the first female general in the Hetmanate's long history. Can you do it?

missions.name: Colonel Chornohuz
missions.description: You've done well! Kniaz Dominik's armies have been annihilated, leading to a brief respite from this unending violence. However, the problem runs deeper than we thought: this time it is Colonel Kozub, Liege of Oleshky Sands, who is behind the chaos. After Kniaz Dominik went down in defeat, Colonel Kozub's stature within Chyhyryn grew, along with his armies and ambition.Colonel Kozub recently dethroned Hetman Verbenko the Grey, replacing him with his younger sister, the newly crowned Hetmanka Olena. Needless to say, Colonel Kozub is now the real power behind the throne. Heroes from around the kingdom have united to declare Colonel Kozub's actions unlawful and unsanctioned. Allied forces are marching to Chyhyryn as we speak! Colonel Chornohuz has organized a band of heroes and is heading to support the Allies. Your job is to engage Colonel Kozub's new vassal, Oksana, the first female general in the Hetmanate's long history. Can you do it?

missions.name: Colonel Syvous
missions.description: You've done well! Kniaz Dominik's armies have been annihilated, leading to a brief respite from this unending violence. However, the problem runs deeper than we thought: this time it is Colonel Kozub, Liege of Oleshky Sands, who is behind the chaos. After Kniaz Dominik went down in defeat, Colonel Kozub's stature within Chyhyryn grew, along with his armies and ambition.Colonel Kozub recently dethroned Hetman Verbenko the Grey, replacing him with his younger sister, the newly crowned Hetmanka Olena. Needless to say, Colonel Kozub is now the real power behind the throne. Heroes from around the kingdom have united to declare Colonel Kozub's actions unlawful and unsanctioned. Allied forces are marching to Chyhyryn as we speak! Colonel Tykhyi of Uman is moving to support the Allies. Your job is to engage Colonel Kozub's new vassal, Oksana, the first female general in the Hetmanate's long history. Can you do it?

missions.name: Colonel Yavir
missions.description: After Kniaz Dominik's Crown army were annihilated, Colonel Kozub's stature as a leader in Chyhyryn grew. Colonel Kozub may be dimwitted and greedy, but he also is an excellent judge of character. He is accompanied by Colonel Zaderykhvist--known to his enemies as the Butcher--and is generally regarded as the strongest man in the Hetmanate.Colonel Kozub has dethroned Verbenko the Grey and declared Verbenko's younger sister, Olena, the new Empress. These actions have turned the people's sentiment against Colonel Kozub, and rebels from around the kingdom have banned together and declared Colonel Kozub's actions unlawful and unsanctioned. These rebels have organized their forces against Colonel Kozub and marched to Chyhyryn. Colonel Tykhyi is leading this rabble. They are now gathered in front of Chortomlyk Fort Gate to unleash their attack. Oksana, the first female general in the Hetmanate's illustrious history, has taken up the sword against the rebels and is requesting reinforcements from us. Your mission objective is to engage Colonel Tykhyi and quell the rebel attack. Will you fight him?

missions.name: Colonel Shabliuk
missions.description: Oksana's forces have been vanquished, and we offer you our thanks for your prominent role in the battle. It is a shame that such a talented general as Oksana is now a footnote in the Hetmanate's history, simply because she served the wrong lord. However, you now have a bigger obstacle ahead of you: the infamous Colonel Zaderykhvist, known as the Butcher. Are you brave enough to challenge him?

missions.name: Colonel Yavir
missions.description: Bad news: the rebel forces who retreated in cowardice have returned! Your valiant effort was for naught. Colonel Zaderykhvist is now on the move to take his revenge against the rebels and has requested your support. Your mission objective is to eliminate Colonel Tykhyi. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Syvous
missions.description: The allies have defeated Colonel Kozub's army, but Colonel Kozub somehow escaped. In the process, he has taken Hetmanka Olena hostage. Chyhyryn has been ransacked and the place now stands deserted. Out of respect for the safety of Hetmanka Olena, the allied forces have decided not to chase Colonel Kozub's forces and have instead dispersed into smaller groups. In another turn of events, Colonel Tykhyi discovered the sought after Royal Seal, and on his way home was promptly attacked by Colonel Topolia of Batih. Colonel Tykhyi was fortunate enough to escape with his life, and is now leading a punitive mission back to Batih to settle the score. Your mission objective is to support Colonel Tykhyi in his counter-attack. Yes or no?

missions.name: Colonel Kremin
missions.description: Colonel Tykhyi has discovered the coveted Royal Seal. Colonel Topolia of Batih ambushed Colonel Tykhyi in hopes of recovering the Royal Seal himself, but good fortune shone upon Colonel Tykhyi and he escaped. Now, Colonel Tykhyi is heading back to Batih for a counter-attack and Colonel Topolia is in distress. Colonel Topolia knows he cannot face an enraged Colonel Tykhyi by himself and has pleaded for support. Your mission objective is to intercept Colonel Tykhyi and stop him. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Shabliuk
missions.description: Colonel Kharko is foolish indeed! It is a good thing Colonel Bairak disassociated with Colonel Kharko prior to the upcoming battle. Here is the story: Colonel Kharko returned to his land, Volhynia, dissatisfied with his holdings, even though he had made off with a modest amount of gold stolen from Chyhyryn. He decided to expand his land by annexing Siveria, a plot of land adjacent to his property.The clever Colonel Tuman became aware of Colonel Kharko's intentions and cooked up a plan to swindle him. Colonel Tuman contacted Colonel Kharko and suggested they jointly attack Siveria and split the land. After Colonel Kharko agreed, Colonel Tuman dispatched a messenger to Colonel Yasen of Siveria to warn him of Colonel Kharko's impending attack on his land. Out of fear, Colonel Yasen asked Colonel Tuman for help, which allowed Colonel Tuman to move into Siveria and bloodlessly conquer the land himself. Colonel Kharko soon learned he had been cheated, and sent his younger brother, Osaul Sava, to deliver a message to Colonel Tuman, demanding his share of the Siveria. In response, Colonel Tuman has executed Osaul Sava, and now an enraged Colonel Kharko is charging towards Colonel Tuman's army, vowing to unleash carnage. Colonel Kharko has requested your support. Will you help him revenge himself upon Colonel Tuman?

missions.name: Colonel Tuman
missions.description: Colonel Tuman sent Colonel Kharko a letter, suggesting they attack Siveria and split the land evenly. Once Colonel Kharko agreed to the plan, Colonel Tuman dispatched a messenger to Colonel Yasen of Siveria warning him of Colonel Kharko's preparation to seize his land. Fearing for his safety, Colonel Yasen asked Colonel Tuman for help. Colonel Tuman agreed and promptly moved into Siveria, conquering it as he went.Colonel Kharko realized that he had been swindled and sent Osaul Sava, his younger brother, to demand his share of Siveria. Instead, Colonel Tuman cold-bloodedly executed Osaul Sava. An enraged Colonel Kharko is now charging towards Colonel Tuman's forces to avenge his brother's death. Colonel Tuman is requesting your support. Your mission objective is to quell Colonel Kharko's assault. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Shabliuk
missions.description: We are reaching the turning point of this battle. Colonel Kharko and Colonel Tuman are now both battling for their very lives: no quarter will be asked, and none given. Colonel Kharko is requesting your support. Your mission objective is to turn the tide of the battle and lead Colonel Kharko to victory. Will you do it?

missions.name: Colonel Tuman
missions.description: We are reaching the turning point of this battle. Colonel Kharko and Colonel Tuman are now both battling for their very lives: no quarter will be asked, and none given. Colonel Tuman is requesting your support. Your mission objective is to turn the tide of the battle and lead  to victory. Will you do it?

missions.name: Colonel Chornohuz
missions.description: After Colonel Dzhura fled from Colonel Chornohuz, Colonel Chornohuz took to harassing Colonel Dzhura's sister-in-law. We have just caught wind of rumors that Colonel Dzhura is planning to assassinate Colonel Chornohuz to protect his family's honor. Colonel Chornohuz is requesting your support. Your mission objective is to protect Colonel Chornohuz from Colonel Dzhura��s assault. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Teren
missions.description: After Colonel Dzhura fled from Colonel Chornohuz, Colonel Chornohuz took to harassing Colonel Dzhura's sister-in-law. We have just caught wind of rumors that Colonel Dzhura is planning to assassinate Colonel Chornohuz to protect his family's honor. Colonel Dzhura has appealed to us for help. Your mission objective is to protect Colonel Chornohuz from Colonel Dzhura��s assault. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Derkach
missions.description: After Colonel Tykhyi's heroic death in battle, Colonel Kosach made his way to Colonel Shulha to ask for help. Colonel Tykhyi's older supporters are now banding together along with fresh troops to press the assault. Colonel Kosach will be defending his uncle against Colonel Tykhyi's supporters in battle and has requested support. Your mission objective is to intercept Colonel Tykhyi's supporters. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Lysytsia
missions.description: After Colonel Tykhyi's heroic death in battle, Colonel Kosach made his way to Colonel Shulha to ask for help. Colonel Tykhyi's older supporters are now banding together along with fresh troops to press the assault. Colonel Kosach will be defending his uncle against Colonel Tykhyi's supporters in battle and has requested support. Your mission objective is to intercept Colonel Tykhyi's supporters. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Bairak
missions.description: Colonel Kozub has been assassinated by Colonel Zaderykhvist, and now Colonel Chornohuz is guarding Hetmanka Olena. In light of this new development, Colonel Bairak and Colonel Zaderykhvist have joined forces. Colonel Chornohuz is wary of their alliance and has thus put in motion a plan to entrap them both. Colonel Shulha is now charging toward Colonel Bairak. Your mission objective is to rendezvous with Colonel Shulha and assault Colonel Bairak. Can you help?

missions.name: Colonel Dubovyk
missions.description: Colonel Kozub has been assassinated by Colonel Zaderykhvist, and now Colonel Chornohuz is guarding Hetmanka Olena. In light of this new development, Colonel Bairak and Colonel Zaderykhvist have joined forces. Colonel Chornohuz is wary of their alliance and has thus put in motion a plan to entrap them both. He has bribed Colonel Shulha to attack Colonel Bairak. Your mission objective is to rendezvous with  and assault . Can you help?

missions.name: Colonel Zaderykhvist
missions.description: Colonel Chornohuz is preparing to capture Colonel Zaderykhvist. Colonel Zaderykhvist has heard about these developments and has appealed for your support. The Hetmanate's strongest man almost always refuses aid, but he needs assistance now. Will you fight for him?

missions.name: Colonel Bairak
missions.description: Colonel Chornohuz is preparing to capture Colonel Zaderykhvist. Colonel Bairak has requested your support during the operation. Will you fight for him?

missions.name: Colonel Chornohuz
missions.description: Colonel Chornohuz is preparing to capture Colonel Zaderykhvist. Knowing that he is in for a fight, Colonel Chornohuz is requesting additional support. Will you fight for him?

missions.name: Colonel Zaderykhvist
missions.description: Colonel Shulha has invoked the power of the Royal Seal that he seized from Colonel Kosach, and has declared himself the new Emperor. Those unwilling to bend the knee to Colonel Shulha are forming up all across the kingdom are marching an army to Colonel Shulha's land. Colonel Zaderykhvist is planning to meet up with them and has requested your support. Your mission is to join the assault on the would-be Emperor. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Bairak
missions.description: Colonel Shulha has invoked the power of the Royal Seal that he seized from Colonel Kosach, and has declared himself the new Emperor. Those unwilling to bend the knee to Colonel Shulha are forming up all across the kingdom are marching an army to Colonel Shulha's land.  Colonel Bairak is also on the way and has requested your support. Your mission is to join the assault on the would-be Emperor. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Chornohuz
missions.description: Colonel Shulha has invoked the power of the Royal Seal that he seized from Colonel Kosach, and has declared himself the new Emperor. Those unwilling to bend the knee to Colonel Shulha are forming up all across the kingdom are marching an army to Colonel Shulha's land.  Colonel Chornohuz is also on the way and has requested your support. Your mission is to join the assault on the would-be Emperor. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Derkach
missions.description: Colonel Shulha has invoked the power of the Royal Seal that he seized from Colonel Kosach, and has declared himself the new Emperor. Those unwilling to bend the knee to Colonel Shulha are forming up all across the kingdom are marching an army to Colonel Shulha's land.  Colonel Kosach is also on the way and has requested your support. Your mission is to join the assault on the would-be Emperor. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Dubovyk
missions.description: Colonel Shulha has invoked the power of the Royal Seal that he seized from Colonel Kosach, and has declared himself the new Emperor. Those unwilling to bend the knee to Colonel Shulha are forming up all across the kingdom are marching an army to Colonel Shulha's land.  Colonel Shulha is in trouble and is desperately pleading for help. Your mission is to join the assault on the would-be Emperor. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Chornohuz
missions.description: Colonel Chornohuz's tactician put into action a plan to assassinate Colonel Bairak covertly. Osaul Zalizo was able to foil the assassination attempt, and killed Colonel Chornohuz's murderous underling in response. A furious Colonel Chornohuz launched an all-out campaign to capture or kill Colonel Bairak and Osaul Hrebinka, but they've somehow managed to escape the onslaught. Now Osaul Zalizo has been left trying to defend Bila Tserkva all by himself. Your objective is to capture Osaul Zalizo. Will you go to Bila Tserkva?

missions.name: Colonel Bairak
missions.description: Colonel Chornohuz's tactician put into action a plan to assassinate Colonel Bairak covertly. Osaul Zalizo was able to foil the assassination attempt, and killed Colonel Chornohuz's murderous underling in response. A furious Colonel Chornohuz launched an all-out campaign to capture or kill Colonel Bairak and Osaul Hrebinka, but they've somehow managed to escape the onslaught. Now Osaul Zalizo has been left trying to defend Bila Tserkva all by himself. Your objective is to Help Osaul Zalizo defend Bila Tserkva. Will you go to Bila Tserkva?

missions.name: Colonel Tuman
missions.description: We are finally reaching the end of this saga. Colonel Tuman and Colonel Chornohuz continue to battle with every ounce of strength they still possess. Colonel Tuman is marching onward toward White Horse Field, but Colonel Chornohuz has been stopped cold by Colonel Tuman's two veteran Generals, Pereima and Brzeski. Your mission objective is to help Colonel Tuman vanquish Colonel Chornohuz's forces. Will you perform this duty?

missions.name: Colonel Chornohuz
missions.description: We are finally reaching the end of this saga. Colonel Tuman and Colonel Chornohuz continue to battle with every ounce of strength they still possess. Colonel Tuman is marching onward toward White Horse Field, but Colonel Chornohuz has been stopped cold by Colonel Tuman's two veteran Generals, Pereima and Brzeski. Your mission objective is to help Colonel Chornohuz vanquish Colonel Tuman's forces. Will you perform this duty?

missions.name: Colonel Tuman
missions.description: Colonel Tuman launched a pre-emptive attack on Colonel Chornohuz, hoping to catch him off guard. 700,000 soldiers loyal to Colonel Tuman have gathered and are heading towards Colonel Chornohuz's manor. It seems clear that the victor of this battle will win control of the entire continent. Colonel Tuman is requesting your support. Your mission objective is to aid in Colonel Tuman's assault on Colonel Chornohuz. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Chornohuz
missions.description: Colonel Tuman launched a pre-emptive attack on Colonel Chornohuz, hoping to catch him off guard. 700,000 soldiers loyal to Colonel Tuman have gathered and are heading towards Colonel Chornohuz's manor. It seems clear that the victor of this battle will win control of the entire continent. Colonel Chornohuz is requesting your support. Your mission objective is to aid in Colonel Tuman's assault on Colonel Chornohuz. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Bairak
missions.description: While languishing in Colonel Chornohuz's captivity, Osaul Zalizo secretly received a letter from Colonel Bairak indicating his position. Osaul Zalizo offered to switch sides and pledge allegiance to Colonel Chornohuz, but Colonel Chornohuz sneeringly refused to release him.To escape Colonel Chornohuz's land, Osaul Zalizo needs a permit that allows him to pass through the five gates separating him from freedom. There's no time for that, however, as Colonel Bairak is pleading for immediate support. Your mission objective is to fight your way through these five gates to penetrate Colonel Chornohuz's forces and meet up with Colonel Bairak. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Bairak
missions.description: After losing the battle at Kodyma Fields, Colonel Bairak left Colonel Tuman's land and settled in Bar Castle. However, Colonel Chornohuz's hatred burns as brightly as ever, and he is dispatching all his troops to run him down. Colonel Bairak is asking you to rescue him. What will you do?

missions.name: Colonel Chornohuz
missions.description: After losing the battle at Kodyma Fields, Colonel Bairak left Colonel Tuman's land and settled in Bar Castle. However, Colonel Chornohuz's hatred burns as brightly as ever, and he is dispatching all his troops to run him down. Colonel Chornohuz needs your assistance to capture Colonel Bairak. What will you do?

missions.name: Colonel Tuman
missions.description: Colonel Tuman has died from an infected wound. Before he passed, he anointed his youngest son, Omelko, as his successor, over the objections of his two elder sons, Khoma and Tymish. Colonel Chornohuz senses an opportunity to strike: he wishes to completely destroy Colonel Tuman's lineage. Colonel Omelko needs your help if he is to stay alive. Will you participate?

missions.name: Colonel Chornohuz
missions.description: Colonel Tuman has died from an infected wound. Before he passed, he anointed his youngest son, Omelko, as his successor, over the objections of his two elder sons, Khoma and Tymish. Colonel Chornohuz senses an opportunity to strike: he wishes to completely destroy Colonel Tuman's lineage. Colonel Chornohuz would like you to help him eliminate the young Colonel Omelko. Will you participate?

missions.name: Colonel Tuman
missions.description: Khoma was killed in the assault, but the target of the operation, Colonel Omelko, managed a daring escape. He has taken up refuge with his remaining brother, Tymish. Colonel Chornohuz wants to finish Colonel Tuman's sons off once and for all. Colonel Omelko is making his last stand, and he won't live long without your help. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Chornohuz
missions.description: Khoma was killed in the assault, but the target of the operation, Colonel Omelko, managed a daring escape. He has taken up refuge with his remaining brother, Tymish. Colonel Chornohuz wants to finish Colonel Tuman's sons off once and for all.  He wishes to retain your services for this strike. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Bairak
missions.description: Colonel Bairak is now under Colonel Topolia's protection. He has hired a talented young commander and is pulling his troops together. Colonel Chornohuz wants them both dead before their forces grow too powerful. Colonel Bairak knows that Colonel Chornohuz's army is on its way, and has requested that you intercept Colonel Chornohuz. Do you want to get involved?

missions.name: Colonel Chornohuz
missions.description: Colonel Bairak is now under Colonel Topolia's protection. He has hired a talented young commander and is pulling his troops together. Colonel Chornohuz wants them both dead before their forces grow too powerful. Colonel Chornohuz will need your help to lay Colonel Bairak low. Do you want to get involved?

missions.name: Colonel Bairak
missions.description: Colonel Chornohuz has put his bitter rival Colonel Bairak in grave peril, but Colonel Bairak will never surrender, as long as blood courses through his veins. Colonel Bairak seeks your sword for the coming battle. Do you agree to fight?

missions.name: Colonel Chornohuz
missions.description: Colonel Chornohuz has put his bitter rival Colonel Bairak in grave peril, but Colonel Bairak will never surrender, as long as blood courses through his veins. Colonel Chornohuz needs you to hunt down Colonel Bairak and finish him. Do you agree to fight?

missions.name: Colonel Voron
missions.description: Colonel Sych, Colonel Kosach's successor, has not been idle. He has recruited many wise and experienced generals to help him take vengeance on Colonel Topolia, on behalf of his father. Colonel Sych wishes you to join his army for this battle. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Kremin
missions.description: Colonel Sych, Colonel Kosach's successor, has not been idle. He has recruited many wise and experienced generals to help him take vengeance on Colonel Topolia, on behalf of his father. Colonel Topolia is requesting your help to protect his land. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Bairak
missions.description: Colonel Chornohuz has lost his last two battles against Colonel Bairak, but these stinging defeats have only caused him to redouble his efforts against his sworn enemy. Colonel Chornohuz's forces are strong, but Colonel Bairak has just discovered a brilliant young commander, Osaul Ternovyi, who is poised to turn the tables on Colonel Chornohuz. Colonel Bairak wishes you to join Osaul Ternovyi in the field. Will you take on this challenge?

missions.name: Colonel Chornohuz
missions.description: Colonel Chornohuz has lost his last two battles against Colonel Bairak, but these stinging defeats have only caused him to redouble his efforts against his sworn enemy. Colonel Chornohuz's forces are strong, but Colonel Bairak has just discovered a brilliant young commander, Osaul Ternovyi, who is poised to turn the tables on Colonel Chornohuz. Accordingly, Colonel Chornohuz is looking for his own secret weapon: you.. Will you take on this challenge?

missions.name: Colonel Bairak
missions.description: Colonel Chornohuz is hot in pursuit of Colonel Bairak, who is being slowed by the sheer number of troops he is leading. Colonel Bairak's ally, Osaul Hrebinka, is doing his best to fend off Colonel Chornohuz's forces, but it looks as though his flanks will soon collapse. Colonel Bairak needs you to halt Colonel Chornohuz's advance. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Chornohuz
missions.description: Colonel Chornohuz is hot in pursuit of Colonel Bairak, who is being slowed by the sheer number of troops he is leading. Colonel Bairak's ally, Osaul Hrebinka, is doing his best to fend off Colonel Chornohuz's forces, but it looks as though his flanks will soon collapse. Colonel Chornohuz is looking to you to defeat Osaul Hrebinka and apprehend Colonel Bairak. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Bairak
missions.description: Colonel Bairak is still on the run from Colonel Chornohuz, who has shown no signs of giving up his single-minded pursuit. Following Osaul Ternovyi's advice, Colonel Bairak has evacuated a hundred thousand of his subjects from his land, and led them in search of a safer haven.Compounding his worries, Colonel Bairak's family has somehow separated from the crowd of refugees. They are believed to be hiding from Colonel Chornohuz's forces somewhere nearby. Colonel Bairak desperately wants his family back! You will have to leave the relative safety of Colonel Bairak's troops to find his missing family. Are you willing to accept the risk?

missions.name: Colonel Bairak
missions.description: The joined forces of Colonels Bairak and Sych are preparing to face off against Colonel Chornohuz's army once more. Colonel Chornohuz's failure to run Colonel Bairak to ground in the previous battle was a personal embarrassment, and he is determined not to fail again. Osaul Ternovyi's sage counsel has served Colonel Bairak in good stead, and he is currently cooking up something new for the next fight. I am not sure what Osaul Ternovyi is working on, but it seems to be vital to his plans for the upcoming battle. Osaul Ternovyi must be protected while he prepares his secret weapon! Colonel Bairak has requested your support. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Chornohuz
missions.description: The joined forces of Colonels Bairak and Sych are preparing to face off against Colonel Chornohuz's army once more. Colonel Chornohuz's failure to run Colonel Bairak to ground in the previous battle was a personal embarrassment, and he is determined not to fail again. Osaul Ternovyi's sage counsel has served Colonel Bairak in good stead, and he is currently cooking up something new for the next fight. I am not sure what Osaul Ternovyi is working on, but it seems to be vital to his plans for the upcoming battle. Osaul Ternovyi must be defeated before he completes his preparations! Colonel Chornohuz has requested your support. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Voron
missions.description: Colonel Sych and Colonel Chornohuz are facing each other on the battlefield. The importance of this fight to the outcome of the war cannot be understated; songs will be sung of the victor for generations.. Privy to the choices of fate as we are, we know who must be the victor. Colonel Sych has requested your support to defeat Colonel Chornohuz. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Chornohuz
missions.description: Colonel Sych and Colonel Chornohuz are facing each other on the battlefield. The importance of this fight to the outcome of the war cannot be understated; songs will be sung of the victor for generations.. Privy to the choices of fate as we are, we know who must be the victor.  Colonel Chornohuz has requested your support to defeat Colonel Sych Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Voron
missions.description: "He changed the direction of a storm and used it to attack the enemy with fire?! Osaul Ternovyi must be a wizard!" Like everyone else, Colonel Sych is now afraid of Osaul Ternovyi's wondrous abilities?even though these same talents once helped to save his own life. Colonel Sych wants to ensure Osaul Ternovyi's miracles are not eventually turned against him. Your mission objective is to capture Osaul Ternovyi, who is making his way back to Colonel Bairak's front line. What is your choice?

missions.name: Colonel Bairak
missions.description: "He changed the direction of a storm and used it to attack the enemy with fire?! Osaul Ternovyi must be a wizard!" Like everyone else, Colonel Sych is now afraid of Osaul Ternovyi's wondrous abilities?even though these same talents once helped to save his own life. Colonel Sych wants to ensure Osaul Ternovyi's miracles are not eventually turned against him. Your mission objective is to guard Osaul Ternovyi and ensure his safe passage to Colonel Bairak's front line. What is your choice?

missions.name: Colonel Bairak
missions.description: Colonel Chornohuz's armies have finally failed, and the defeated noble is retreating from the battlefield in disgrace. Colonel Bairak wants to prevent Colonel Chornohuz from escaping, and requires your assistance. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Chornohuz
missions.description: Colonel Chornohuz's armies have finally failed, and the defeated noble is retreating from the battlefield in disgrace. Colonel Chornohuz will need your assistance to make good his escape. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Voron
missions.description: Even though Colonel Chornohuz met a shameful defeat and retreated, Colonel Sych chose to press his advantage all the way to the borders of Colonel Chornohuz's manor. Of course, the fiery Colonel Chornohuz has vowed never to capitulate or retreat! Even though he had the upper hand, Colonel Sych was nearly captured by Colonel Chornohuz, who surely would have put him to death. Now, a chastened Colonel Sych is using a decoy to lure Colonel Chornohuz to Kruta Balka. Colonel Sych has requested your support. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Holota
missions.description: Colonel Kurylo, who lost his father at the hands of Colonel Chornohuz, is seeking revenge. Colonel Kurylo is known throughout the realm as Hlib Kurylo because of his courage and valor, and he has allied himself with Colonel Kulish in an effort to destroy the reeling Colonel Chornohuz. Now, the military genius Osaul Ternovyi has lured Colonel Chornohuz into a battle at Chernecha Hora. Colonel Kurylo has requested your support. Will you help him?

missions.name: Colonel Chornohuz
missions.description: Colonel Kurylo, who lost his father at the hands of Colonel Chornohuz, is seeking revenge. Colonel Kurylo is known throughout the realm as Hlib Kurylo because of his courage and valor, and he has allied himself with Colonel Kulish in an effort to destroy the reeling Colonel Chornohuz. Now, the military genius Osaul Ternovyi has lured Colonel Chornohuz into a battle at Chernecha Hora. Colonel Chornohuz has requested your support. Will you help him?

missions.name: Colonel Holota
missions.description: Colonel Kurylo is blessed with many personal strengths, but prudence is not one of them. Colonel Chornohuz managed to trick Hlib Kurylo into a quarrel with Colonel Kulish by planting an incriminating document in Colonel Kulish's camp. In the ensuing confrontation, Colonel Kurylo wounded Colonel Kulish, who quit the alliance. Now, Colonel Kurylo is standing alone against Colonel Chornohuz's frenzied charge. He is in desperate need of a hero to take his side. Will you join him?

missions.name: Colonel Chornohuz
missions.description: Colonel Chornohuz killed Colonel Kurylo's father, and now Hlib Kurylo is seeking revenge. He has employed the military genius Osaul Ternovyi to lure Colonel Chornohuz into a battle at Chernecha Hora. Colonel Chornohuz, suspecting a trap, has requested your support. Will you help him?

missions.name: Lady Buriak
missions.description: Colonel Chornohuz, wishing to cement his dynasty, has forced Lady Kvitka, a first cousin to Hetmanka Olena who owns many titled lands of her own, to marry his son. To further punish Colonel Bairak and Colonel Sych, Colonel Chornohuz is attacking Colonel Rudyi of Inhul Steppe, and plans establish his headquarters on Colonel Rudyi's manor. Colonel Rudyi has requested your support. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Chornohuz
missions.description: Colonel Chornohuz, wishing to cement his dynasty, has forced Lady Kvitka, a first cousin to Hetmanka Olena who owns many titled lands of her own, to marry his son. To further punish Colonel Bairak and Colonel Sych, Colonel Chornohuz is attacking Colonel Rudyi of Inhul Steppe, and plans establish his headquarters on Colonel Rudyi's manor. Colonel Chornohuz has requested your support. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Bairak
missions.description: Colonel Bairak is pushing his forces forward in an effort to take over Podillia. Svitiaz, Colonel Bars's domain, is his first target. Colonel Bairak needs your aid. What say you?

missions.name: Colonel Sokyra
missions.description: Colonel Bairak is pushing his forces forward in an effort to take over Podillia. Svitiaz, Colonel Bars's domain, is his first target. Colonel Bars needs your aid. What say you?

missions.name: Colonel Bairak
missions.description: Colonel Bairak has ordered Osaul Bilyk to attack Berestechko Marshes. It should be an easy victory, but one never knows. Colonel Bairak has requested your support. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Korzhyk
missions.description: Colonel Bairak has ordered Osaul Bilyk to attack Berestechko Marshes. Colonel Zaiats, a true coward, is terrified of losing the fight. Colonel Bairak has requested your support. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Bairak
missions.description: Osaul Hrebinka is leading his troops to Bura Mohyla. Colonel Bairak has requested that you join him to attack Colonel Ptakha's encampment on Bura Mohyla. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Siroshapka
missions.description: Osaul Hrebinka is leading his troops to Bura Mohyla. Colonel Ptakha has requested that you join him to defend against Osaul Hrebinka's assault on Bura Mohyla. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Bairak
missions.description: Ochakiv, a vital strategic chokepoint, is under the protection of a pair of legendary warriors, Vakula and Nazar. Therefore, winning control of the port will not be a simple task. Your mission objective is to help Colonel Bairak and conquer Ochakiv. Will you take this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Huska
missions.description: Ochakiv, a vital strategic chokepoint, is under the protection of a pair of legendary warriors, Vakula and Nazar. Even so, defending the port from Colonel Bairak's armies will not be an easy task. Your mission objective is to help Colonel Hulak and defend Ochakiv. Will you take this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Bairak
missions.description: Colonel Bairak's armies are a sword pointed at the very heart of Podillia. Our intelligence has become aware of a plan to assassinate Colonel Bairak at Kamianets, the first gate to Podillia's interior. Colonel Bairak wishes to take no chances, and is requesting your protection. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Pidhornyi
missions.description: Colonel Bairak's armies are a sword pointed at the very heart of Podillia. Our intelligence has become aware of a plan to assassinate Colonel Bairak at Kamianets, the first gate to Podillia's interior. Colonel Bilous, who controls Podillia, wants you to help kill Colonel Bairak. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Bairak
missions.description: Colonel Bilous has decided to defend the Podillia mainland to the last man. However, Colonel Bairak has lost the commander of his main force, Osaul Tulub, in the last battle. Colonel Bairak has requested your help in rallying his men. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Pidhornyi
missions.description: Colonel Bilous has decided to defend the Podillia mainland to the last man. However, Colonel Bairak has lost the commander of his main force, Osaul Tulub, in the last battle. Colonel Bilous has requested your help in rallying his men. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Bairak
missions.description: Colonel Bairak's forces are advancing towards both of Colonel Bilous's flanks simultaneously. If these two bastions fall, the the soft underbelly of Podillia will be exposed to Colonel Bairak's armies. Colonel Bairak needs your help to assault these two vital locations. Do you accept the challenge?

missions.name: Colonel Bairak
missions.description: Colonel Bilous has requested backup from Colonel Rudyi, who has in turn sent in Colonel Kurylo for reinforcements. Colonel Dzhura, one of Colonel Bairak's vassals, has countered this maneuver by ordering Osaul Ternovyi to support him, and now the two forces are assembling for battle at Wild Field. Colonel Bairak is looking to you to defeat Colonel Kurylo's forces. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Bairak
missions.description: The victorious Colonel Bairak, now liege lord of Podillia, plans to build on his great triumph by moving into the middle of the Hetmanate. Colonel Chornohuz, Colonel Bairak's old nemesis, is laying in wait for him. Colonel Bairak has requested your support to defeat Colonel Chornohuz's forces. Do you accept this mission?

Colonel Chornohuz, Colonel Bairak's old nemesis, is laying in wait for him. Colonel Chornohuz  has requested your support to defeat Colonel Bairak's forces. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Voron
missions.description: Colonel Chornohuz's and Colonel Sych's armies have been skirmishing for the past month at Tiasmyn, but neither has gained an advantage. It is time to settle this once and for all. Colonel Sych is about to launch another assault on Colonel Chornohuz, and has requested your support. What say you?

missions.name: Colonel Chornohuz
missions.description: Colonel Chornohuz's and Colonel Sych's armies have been skirmishing for the past month at Tiasmyn, but neither has gained an advantage. It is time to settle this once and for all. Colonel Chornohuz is about to launch another assault on Colonel Sych, and has requested your support. What say you?

missions.name: Colonel Bairak
missions.description: Osaul Zalizo is surrounded by Colonel Sych's forces, and will soon taste defeat. Colonel Bairak needs you to break through Colonel Sych's lines and rescue him. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Voron
missions.description: Osaul Zalizo is surrounded by Colonel Sych's forces, and will soon taste defeat. Colonel Sych, knowing that Osaul Zalizo will not give up easily, is in need of some mercenary assistance. Do you accept this mission?

missions.name: Colonel Bairak
missions.description: Osaul Zalizo has been killed. Colonel Bairak was distraught over his death, and unleashed his wrath against Colonel Sych's position. Colonel Bairak had some success on the battlefield at first, but now his forces are in a precarious position. Your mission objective is to save Colonel Bairak. Do you accept this mission?
